collisionPolicy: All structurally valid Active observations with nonempty canonical SerialKey participate in the current snapshot's collision counts, including observations that cannot publish a SourceId because their slot generation is exhausted.

GenerationExhausted remains a per-slot AppliedWithErrors diagnostic. It does not create, wrap or reuse an exhausted SourceId. A publishable peer reporting the same SerialKey must remain Ambiguous and use session identity; failure to publish one slot is not proof of unique physical identity.

Only actual omission or an explicitly inactive state removes an observation from collision eligibility. A later snapshot with no other eligible matching observation permits collision exit under the existing identity-epoch policy.
This clarification changes no raw-input, OS-adapter, mapping, calibration or persistence contract. Synthetic reflection fixtures may exercise the generation boundary without a production test hook.
reason: Root source review found that counting serials only after successful generation allocation could make a live duplicate appear unique at the generation-exhaustion boundary.
